notes: Revision 9 adds formation_close and formation_open only: six equal-scale top-view jingasa markers per image on a pale ivory aged-paper plaque with a dark-brown border. The 240x120 display canvas keeps 14px transparent padding above and below the flatter visible plaque. Both formation states share one mutually exclusive candidate position at (734,1042). This position was checked only against frame boundaries and one existing 槍足軽隊 front card; no all-troop or runtime validation, new previews, or overview was produced. Existing engaged and out_of_command asset entries remain unchanged.

Revision 8 changes only out_of_command to a rustic, non-reflective finish: matte aged wood, subdued dark-gold earth-toned edging, and a black diagonal slash. Its black-lacquered waisted gunbai shape, approximately 25-degree tilt, dark vermilion badge, no-lettering treatment, dimensions and placement remain unchanged. Engaged remains unchanged.

No new overview or board previews are generated for revision 8, at the user’s request. The current overview points to the standalone out_of_command.png; all older out_of_command and combined preview references are explicitly historical revision 5 assets.

The engaged badge uses a 100x100 canvas at (20,56), centered at (70,106). The out_of_command badge uses a separate 100x100 canvas at (892,56), centered at (942,106). Both can appear simultaneously; do not reuse one mutually exclusive display slot.
The right badge is placed beyond the rightmost title boundary x=885 exclusive, leaving a 7px title gap and a 6px right-frame gap. No existing title needs to move or shrink.
Cloud URLs intentionally empty; no runtime-hosting URLs have been provided.
Only the area outside each circular badge is transparent; both badge interiors are solid.
At a 300px-wide board each 100px placement becomes 25px; final readability requires TTS distance and angle testing.
Alpha>0 bounding boxes include faint antialias pixels; both 100px exports reach their canvas bounds while the main circular contours retain about one pixel of clearance.
Back previews are charcoal contrast/layout illustrations, not captured or reconstructed TTS backs.
This handoff defines artwork and placement only, not automatic state detection, timing, persistence, or reset rules.
